_schema: Contact config consumed by templates as {{cfg.KEY}} (resolved in functions/_lib/render.js renderPage, NOT via the i18n catalog — so these values never hit catalog-dupe). Admin edits this file and republishes via the same CMS write-back as the Hero copy. ⚠️ 这里【不是】"language-agnostic values" —— 那个旧描述曾经名不副实:它当时还装着 hours(Mon–Fri…)与 response(within 1 business day),两句英文,结果 es/pt 页面上的营业时间是英文而 meta description 是西/葡语。那两个键已移进 i18n catalog(data/pages/contact.json 的 contact.value.*)。剩下的是【不随语言变化的事实值】:电话/邮箱/微信号/二维码/链接,加上 address —— address 留在这里不是因为它语言无关,而是【刻意不译】:中国地址要能被国际快递照着写和投递,把 Road 译成 Calle 会让它在寄件时变成错的;只有它的标签走 i18n。
address: No. 62, Baotian 1st Road, Xixiang Street, Bao'an District, Shenzhen, Guangdong, China
